КУБОХОД — asset provenance

PROJECT ARTWORK
The original backgrounds, basic surface textures, app icon and earlier skin
previews were created for this project with scripts/create-assets.py.
The interface icons and stars under ui/ were created with OpenAI's built-in
ImageGen; their production prompt is recorded in ui/provenance.json.
The aurora, nebula and ember backgrounds, marble/galaxy/walnut textures and
secret-shop capsule were created with the same built-in ImageGen tool.
Their prompts, filenames and export details are in cosmetic-provenance.json.
Skin thumbnails are rendered from the game's actual mesh and materials by
scripts/render-shop-previews.mjs. Glass, gold, glitter and obsidian surfaces
use native Canvas shading and the same depth clipping as the other blocks.
All shipped icons and backgrounds are raster assets; no SVG or icon font
is required. The interface uses the system sans-serif font.

SOUND EFFECTS
Recorded effects in sfx/ are project edits of Kenney's Impact Sounds,
Interface Sounds and Music Jingles packs, released under Creative Commons
Zero (CC0 1.0). Their original license notices are retained as:
  sfx/LICENSE-impact.txt
  sfx/LICENSE-interface.txt
  sfx/LICENSE-jingles.txt
Exact source files, source links and processing are listed in sfx/manifest.json.
Source: https://kenney.nl/
CC0 text: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

MUSIC
music.mp3 was supplied by the project owner and included at their request.
No independent CC0 or public-domain status is asserted for this recording.

The CC0 notices apply to the credited Kenney sound packs. They do not apply
to the supplied music, generated/project artwork, or the game source code.
